messages:
carlos: Noticed odd spikes in per-route quota for a couple customers this morning. Dashboard shows duplicate keys for the same tenant.
mia: Any idea which client emitted the duplicates?
carlos: Correlation points to a recent change: the TS SDK added `x-rw-context` as structured json while Python kept `rw_context` (snake_case) single header.
harry: That's... messy. Console expects a single canonical header value. Two shapes = two quota buckets.
mia: Can we canonicalize at the edge (ingress proxy) instead of changing every SDK? Might be faster.
carlos: Ingress team said they'd rather not mutate headers for security/audit reasons. They prefer clients to send canonical shape.
harry: Ok, fallback plan then: Console should merge equivalent attributions when frequency indicates same tenant within 5 minutes and identical acct id. Score-based merging fallback.
mia: I worry about false merges. What if route tag legitimately changes? We should only merge when acct id matches and route tag absent in one header.
carlos: Agreed. I'll add logic: if acct==acct and (routeA == routeB OR one route missing) then collapse under acct route=unknown flag.
harry: SDK plan: Mia, can the TS SDK emit canonical `X-Redwood-Context: acct=team-xyz;route=NAME`? And set sampling flag for telemetry to 0.1 by default?
mia: Yeah TS will add a normalization layer in request middleware. Default sampling 10% and opt-out via env. Will include a migration note.
carlos: Python: we need to make the structured header the default, but with a runtime toggle to preserve until migration window ends.
harry: Go SDK currently inlining context into token claims for perf - switching header will add a call. We should add a no-op header when that path used so Console sees canonical header but perf unchanged.
mia: I'll draft the TS PR with tests for mixed-case headers, missing fields, and telemetry flag.
carlos: Console UX: add small badge next to quota chart: "Attribution source: header | token | inferred". Clicking it shows examples and migration docs.
harry: Telemetry: since headers differ, sampling will be skewed. Add a metric in the console to show percent of requests with canonical header vs legacy. That'll help customers and SREs.
ops-bot: alert: synthetic job failure for migration-test-suite on canary at 2026-04-02T09:00Z. See pipeline 8842.
mia: I'll pause the TS canary until tests reconcile header shapes. Thanks ops-bot.
carlos: Action items: Mia -> TS PR + tests, Python owners -> default to structured header behind flag off after two weeks, Harry -> Go shim to emit no-op canonical header. Console -> badge + metric + merge heuristic.
mia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-ts/pull/503 (includes middleware & sampling opt-out).
harry: I'll put up Go shim PR by EOD and include perf bench.
carlos: Great. Follow-up in #devex-standup tomorrow to verify quotas normalized.
